Egyptian AI-powered e-commerce logistics/fintech platform, HQ Cairo. Founded 2023 by Mostafa Elmasry (CEO & Co-founder) and Nihal Ali (COO & Co-founder). Connects merchants to 40+ couriers across Africa, handles COD reconciliation, working-capital advances, and AI-driven customer retention. Raised $2.8M Seed (Jul 2026, led by Launch Africa & Antler MENAP) after a Pre-Seed round (Jan 2025, led by Plus VC). Serves 450+ merchants (fashion, cosmetics, electronics). LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/fincartio. Personal LinkedIn for CEO not confirmed publicly — needs manual lookup/connection request.

leads.company: El Mostakbal for Urban Development (Mostakbal City)
leads.notes: Master developer and owner of Mostakbal City, a 45M sqm / 11,000-acre mixed-use mega-development in East Cairo (New Cairo extension), founded 2006. Shareholders include Banque Misr, National Investment Bank, National Bank of Egypt, and Arab Contractors. Acts as master planner/land seller to sub-developers (Palm Hills, Hassan Allam, SODIC, Emaar Misr, Misr Italia, Tatweer Misr, etc.) who build the actual residential/commercial compounds inside the city. No confirmed official company website found in public search results — recommend verifying directly before outreach. Instagram: instagram.com/mostakbal_city_official.
